title: Reporting period
text: The catalog build date records when this list was generated. If a feed has no vintage or verification date, check the individual dataset before describing a figure as current.

title: Automated access and reuse
text: A blank license means the catalog has no recorded reuse terms. Read the publisher’s terms and any access note before fetching upstream data. Use an AccessMI download when one is listed.

title: Missing values and county comparisons
text: Keep the geography, period, source and uncertainty with each estimate. Leave unavailable values blank. A zero is a reported value. Overlapping confidence intervals alone cannot establish which county has the higher underlying rate.
